headlines.text: Rewind to 2022, when after 2 matches, Nese & Woods debuted a bold new identity: The Varsity Athletes, on Rampage.
Back on this day in 2020, Rey Fenix vs. Penta El Zero M met in a Tournament Match on Dynamite, rated 8.30 ? an excellent showing.
It was 2023 when Bryan Danielson vs. Andrade El Idolo locked horns for the first time, getting things started right out of the gate on Collision, rated 7.97 ? a well-worked match.

secondaries.text: On this day in 2023, the AEW TBS Title was up for grabs as Kris Statlander vs. Willow Nightingale went to war, appearing on Battle of the Belts, rated 6.56.

On a Saturday in 2023, back when Bill & Starks vs. Castagnoli & Yuta fought tooth and nail for the AEW World Tag Team Titles, appearing on Collision, rated 6.59. Bill & Starks was challenging for gold for the very first time.
Looking back to 2020, when Dynamite stood out as one of AEW's best-received shows of the year, rated 8.53.
